voice.name: Open Sector - Rig
voice.description: Older male construction-crew foreman in his fifties speaking over a vehicle radio, deep gruff steady baritone with a rough smoker's rasp, slow patient and unshakeable, blue-collar heavy-machinery veteran, dry humor, sounds like he has parked a thousand trucks and nothing surprises him anymore.
voice.sample: Rig here, rolling slow and steady. Point me at flat ground and I'll unpack you a whole headquarters before lunch. Don't rush the big girl, she gets there when she gets there.

move.prompt: Huge heavy diesel truck engine revving up and starting to roll, deep rumbling exhaust and gear grind, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Heavy mobile base vehicle deploying: loud hydraulic pistons hissing, large steel panels unfolding and clanking into place, motors whirring, metal locking clunk at the end, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Large armored truck explosion: massive blast, metal tearing apart, debris raining down, fire roaring, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
